design: Unbalanced counts: one singleton, one three-observation locally aliased taxon, and 30 lognormal-count taxa. Correlated predictors (0.65 shared Gaussian factor), two shared nuisance columns correlated with exposures, and an eight-term spherical spatial basis. Predictors stay on common generating units. Taxon slope deviations have SD 0.45 for every coordinate; the first hypermean is zero, remaining coordinates have mean 0.3.
errors: IID scenarios use observation SD1. The spatial stress case uses sqrt(0.35)*iid plus sqrt(0.65)*shared Gaussian error in each of24 broad source cells, even though a spherical mean basis is in the fitted model. This deliberately probes a violated independent-error working likelihood.
report: Record every replicate, optimizer success/failure and all attempts; retained taxon count, first hypermean and conditional working-model SE, first tau, null rejection using absolute z>1.959963984540054, coverage, and Wilson95 intervals. Failed fits stay in the planned denominator and no probability is invented.
scope: Evaluate numerical behavior and show the limitation of conditional SEs. These checks do not validate the unfinished source-component/spatial-block bootstrap, cross-response module statistic, direct among-minus-within contrast, or ecological claims. No scenario or seed is selected from empirical v3 outcomes.
